# HordeLedger

> Auction house prices and market analysis for World of Warcraft: WoW Forever, US PvP, Horde. Updated hourly from Blizzard's Game Data API. Every item page states the current market price, cheapest listing, units listed, 7-day range, estimated sales per day, best hours to sell (US Central) and a posting tip, in plain text.

Data last updated 2026-11-21 9:00 US Central. Money is gold (g), silver (s) and copper (c); 1g = 100s = 10000c. "Market price" is the average unit price of the cheapest 25% of units listed. Prices are for one realm's Horde auction house; other realms differ. Fan project, not affiliated with Blizzard.

## Main pages
- [Market dashboard](https://hordeledger.com/market/): every listed item, searchable and sortable
- [Crafting materials](https://hordeledger.com/materials/): the busiest herbs, ores, bars, cloth, leather and enchanting materials with 14-day trends
- [Prices by category](https://hordeledger.com/items/): herbs, ore, cloth, leather, ammo, consumables, recipes and more
- [Blog](https://hordeledger.com/blog/): market analysis
- [About and method](https://hordeledger.com/about/): data sources, how numbers are calculated, privacy

## Data
- [market.csv](https://hordeledger.com/data/market.csv): current price table for all listed items (copper)

## Blog posts
- [Firebloom and Sungrass Tripled at Dawn. Such Spikes Rarely Last a Day](https://hordeledger.com/blog/2026-11-21-firebloom-sungrass-tripled-spikes-rarely-last-a-day/): Four materials jumped 2x to 17x at the 06:43 scan. Of 895 similar spikes this week, 71% were back near the old price within 12 hours. Sell fast or wait.
- [Flasks Cost 16g to Brew, and the Margin Is Shrinking by the Day](https://hordeledger.com/blog/2026-11-20-flasks-cost-16g-to-brew-and-the-margin-is-shrinking/): Black Lotus at 9g 48s puts a flask at about 16g in materials. Brewing still pays, but Supreme Power's margin fell from 8g to 2g 80s in two days.
- [The Blackmaw Hold Gold Exploit: What the Auction House Shows](https://hordeledger.com/blog/2026-11-19-blackmaw-hold-gold-exploit-what-the-auction-house-shows/): Hourly Horde auction house scans across the Blackmaw Hold gold exploit: no price jump. Goods over 10g fell 36% from Nov 13 to 19; Arcanite rose before it went public.
- [Blue Dragonscale Fell 98% in Nine Days. Black Still Costs 16x More](https://hordeledger.com/blog/2026-11-19-blue-dragonscale-fell-98-percent-in-nine-days/): Blue Dragonscale slid from 4g 8s to 7s 85c, close to its 5s vendor price. Green and Worn are already there. Black holds at 1g 30s and sells fastest.
- [First Darkmoon Faire: Bear Pelts Tripled, Then Gave It All Back](https://hordeledger.com/blog/2026-11-17-first-darkmoon-faire-bear-pelts-tripled-then-gave-it-back/): Torn Bear Pelt went from 1s 22c to 4s 45c on day two of the first Darkmoon Faire, then back to 1s 20c. Crafted turn-ins never moved.
- [Journeyman Crates Up Sevenfold, Artisan Crates Down 99%](https://hordeledger.com/blog/2026-11-16-journeyman-crates-up-sevenfold-artisan-crates-down-99/): Waylaid Crates and Sealed Writs split by tier this week: low tiers doubled or more on thinner stock, while Artisan supply grew twelvefold and prices collapsed.
- [Prices Fell 18% This Week, but Raw Materials Have Stopped](https://hordeledger.com/blog/2026-11-15-prices-down-18-but-raw-materials-have-stopped-falling/): The Horde price index is down 18% on the week, yet trade goods have been flat for three days. Potions, recipes and gear are still falling.
- [Level-50 Blues Are Halving: Wait to Buy, List Fast](https://hordeledger.com/blog/2026-11-14-level-50-blues-are-halving-wait-to-buy/): Rare gear for level 48+ on the Horde auction house has lost 38% in two days as listings quadrupled. Why the cheap ones aren't flips yet.
- [Smelting Pays More the Higher the Skill Gate](https://hordeledger.com/blog/2026-11-13-smelting-pays-more-the-higher-the-skill-gate/): Thorium Bar clears about 7s over Thorium Ore after the auction cut; copper and tin clear nothing. Smelting margins on the Horde AH, by skill level.
- [Five Cheap Staples Repriced Overnight](https://hordeledger.com/blog/2026-11-12-five-cheap-staples-repriced-overnight/): Small Venom Sac, Fish Bowl, Elemental Water and two more jumped 3x to 1,900x in one night on the Horde AH. Which moves are holding and which aren't.
- [Silk, Heavy Leather and Iron Bar Hit the Vendor Floor](https://hordeledger.com/blog/2026-11-11-silk-heavy-leather-iron-bar-hit-the-vendor-floor/): Iron Bar, Silk Cloth and Heavy Leather are down about 90% since launch and now trade within 20-30% of vendor price: little downside left for crafters.
- [The first 72 hours of the Horde auction house](https://hordeledger.com/blog/launch-week/): We watched one WoW Forever auction house from launch night on. Prices halved, ammo ran a third of all volume, and most listings that vanish come straight back cheaper. Ten things that stood out.
